decision.summary: The v1 contract is stable: create-time issue bodies keep an empty Context section, conclusion-time issue bodies use the dedicated LLM authoring path, and the retired deterministic Context builders have been removed from the shared contract module.

boundary_rules: Do not reintroduce deterministic draft or conclusion Context builders through shared contract helpers.
Do keep create-time Context structurally present but empty until conclusion owns the first substantive Context write-back.
Do keep exact sentence-count validation at four for child issues and five for top-level parent issues.
Do fail closed on conclusion-time LLM generation errors instead of silently falling back to template assembly.
